comparison.objective: Rearrange canisters with the fewest moves to separate fuel from oxidizer; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Constraint planning and upright canister relocation versus small-tool alignment, bimanual counterholding, tuning, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: No fuel shares a wall with oxidizer, every canister is upright, and moves are minimized versus repeatable safe carriage stopping and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both impose safety constraints, but their physical mechanisms and tested abilities differ.
